en.headline: Tung Wah social enterprises open care food exhibition in Admiralty
en.dek: The CookEasy and iBakery exhibition on soft meals runs until 31 March at the iBakery Gallery Café in Tamar Park, featuring stories from ten guests including celebrities and care home residents.
body: Tung Wah Group of Hospitals’ social enterprises CookEasy and iBakery have opened an exhibition titled “Everyone Can Eat Well 2026” at the iBakery Gallery Café in Tamar Park, Admiralty. The display runs until 31 March next year.

The exhibition uses the theme of time to present food stories from ten guests, including Tung Wah chairman Kenneth Tsang, entertainer Jan Lamb, chef Cheung Kam-cheung and care home residents. Each guest is shown through past photographs, portraits by disabled artists and AI-simulated older appearances.

Organisers said the aim is to show that nutritious and attractive soft meals can be prepared for people with reduced chewing ability, so that good eating is not limited by age or dental condition. The first edition of the exhibition received positive feedback, they said.
The display is free to visit at the café in Tamar Park. Tung Wah said it continues to develop care food options through its social enterprises.

zh.headline: 東華三院社企開辦照護食展覽 展至明年三月
zh.dek: 煮餥易及愛烘焙的「人人都可以食得好 2026」展覽即日起至明年三月三十一日於添馬公園愛烘焙茶座舉行，展出十位嘉賓的飲食故事。
body: 東華三院旗下社企煮餥易及愛烘焙餐廳在金鐘添馬公園添馬茶座的愛烘焙畫廊咖啡廳，開辦「人人都可以食得好 2026」主題展覽，展期至明年三月三十一日。
展覽以「時間」為題，呈現十位嘉賓的飲食故事，包括東華三院主席曾慶業、藝人林海峰、大廚張錦祥以及護理安老院院友等。每位嘉賓以昔日舊照、殘疾藝術家人像畫及人工智能模擬老年樣貌的作品展出。
主辦方表示，希望顯示即使咀嚼能力減弱，仍可透過適當方法準備營養豐富且賣相精緻的軟餐，讓「食得好」不受年齡或牙齒狀況限制。首屆展覽獲得正面迴響。
展覽在添馬公園茶座免費參觀。東華三院表示會繼續透過社企發展照護食選擇。
